name: @biofigure-lab/api
description: The server part of BioFigure Lab: one Cloudflare Worker that serves the app files and /api

scripts.dev: node -e "require('node:fs').mkdirSync('../../dist',{recursive:true})" && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev --port 8787
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote && wrangler deploy
